label: Double Forward Pleats
description: Double forward pleats add a second, smaller inward-facing fold between the main pleat and the pocket, helping the main pleat stay closed. They provide generous room through the hip and thigh for a fuller, more classic drape while preserving the neat inward-facing English line. This is a traditional dressy detail seen on high-rise tailored trousers.
